chunks: Regarding the man and the woman both found in one quilt, he said: 'They would both be whipped one hundred lashes each, minus one lash.'

key_terms.غَيْرَ سَوْطٍ: minus one lash — the deliberate reduction from the full hadd of one hundred, marking this as a lesser offense than fornication
key_terms.لِحَافٍ وَاحِدٍ: one quilt — the circumstantial evidence of being found together under shared bedding, short of proven zina
key_terms.مِائَةً مِائَةً: one hundred each — the dual repetition of the number emphasizing each individual receives the punishment separately
key_terms.يُجْلَدَانِ: they shall be whipped — the passive dual indicating both parties receive the punishment equally

ai.seo_question: What is the Islamic ruling on a man and woman found together in one bed or quilt according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) issues a legal ruling regarding a man and woman discovered together under a single quilt, prescribing a punishment of ninety-nine lashes for each. This ruling addresses a situation that falls short of proven fornication (zina) but constitutes a prohibited seclusion (khalwa) that warrants a discretionary hadd-adjacent punishment. The reduction of one lash from the full hundred — the prescribed punishment for fornication — distinguishes this ruling from the full hadd, reflecting Islamic jurisprudential precision in calibrating punishment to the level of proven offense.
